items.title: Acyclicity of the pushforward of an injective sheaf for the Leray spectral sequence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the acyclicity needed for the Leray spectral sequence: for an injective abelian sheaf I on X_etale and an object V of Y_etale, the pushforward f_*I has vanishing Cech cohomology, is acyclic for the sections functor at V, and is acyclic for the pushforward along any further morphism (statement lines 8145-8155). The proof establishes the Cech vanishing for coverings of V (proof lines 8157-8162) and then applies the acyclicity criterion of the same chapter in the two remaining cases (proof lines 8162-8169). The non-formal content is the Cech computation for the pushforward of an injective sheaf. The claim is H2: one vanishing computation plus one criterion.
